<p>Claude Sonnet 5.5 has the same prices as Claude Sonnet 5, except for prompt cache reads, which cost $0.10 USD per million tokens, half the Claude Sonnet 5 rate. See <a href="/docs/en/about-claude/pricing">Claude pricing</a>. For its context window and output limits, see the <a href="/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview">Claude Sonnet 5.5 model page</a>. For features and prompting, see <a href="/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5#feature-support">What&#x27;s new in Claude Sonnet 5.5</a> and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5-5">Prompting Claude Sonnet 5.5</a>.</p>

<p>This request works on Claude Sonnet 5.5 as written. It sets an effort level, and the SDK tabs read the reply by block type. It leaves out five settings that return a 400 error: <a href="#sonnet-46-breaking-changes">thinking budgets</a>, <a href="#sonnet-46-breaking-changes">sampling parameters</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-sonnet-45">assistant prefill</a>, <a href="#forced-tool-use">forced tool choice</a>, and <a href="#turn-off-up-front-thinking"><code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code></a>.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> block </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> response.content:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> block.type </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">==</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> "text"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">        print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">(block.text)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div></div></div>
<h2 id="thinking-on-by-default" class="group">Thinking runs by default<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_21v6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>On Claude Sonnet 5.5, a request with no <code>thinking</code> field runs with <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking">adaptive thinking</a>, as does <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code>. On Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models and on Claude Haiku 4.5, that request ran without thinking. To keep running without up-front thinking, see <a href="#turn-off-up-front-thinking">Turn off up-front thinking</a>.</p>

<h3 id="thinking-in-responses" class="group">Handle thinking in responses<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_22n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Code that ran without thinking needs all three items. Code from Claude Sonnet 5 likely has the first two.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Read content blocks by <code>type</code>.</strong> A response can begin with <code>thinking</code> blocks, so code that reads <code>content[0].text</code> breaks.</li>
<li><strong>Pass <code>thinking</code> blocks back unchanged</strong> in tool-use loops, including empty ones. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#preserving-thinking-blocks">Preserving thinking blocks</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Revisit <code>max_tokens</code>.</strong> It covers thinking plus text, and thinking tokens are billed as output tokens. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-steering-and-cost#cost-control">Cost control</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p>Thinking text is omitted by default. <code>thinking</code> blocks arrive with an empty <code>thinking</code> field and a <code>signature</code>. To get readable summaries, set <code>display: &quot;summarized&quot;</code>, the default on Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models and on Claude Haiku 4.5. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#controlling-thinking-display">Controlling thinking display</a>.</p>
<h3 id="turn-off-up-front-thinking" class="group">Turn off up-front thinking<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_23n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p><span id="turn-thinking-off"></span><span id="thinking-off-at-high-effort"></span>To turn off up-front thinking on Claude Sonnet 5.5, send <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;between_tools&quot;}</code>. It&#x27;s the lowest thinking setting. Its progress updates between tool calls still come back as <code>thinking</code> blocks with their summary text. Without tools, the response contains only text. Claude Sonnet 5 turns thinking off with <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code> instead, and earlier models run without thinking by default. On Claude Sonnet 5.5, <code>disabled</code> returns a 400 <code>invalid_request_error</code>:</p>
<div data-not-prose="true" class="overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface-2 group relative"><div data-copy-scope="" class="code-block-scroll relative py-4 pl-4 text-code code-block-wrap"><pre class="block w-full pr-4" data-code-source="" translate="no"><code>To turn thinking off on this model, send &quot;thinking&quot;: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;between_tools&quot;} instead of {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}. The model does not think before responding. The short updates it writes between tool calls come back as thinking blocks.</code></pre></div><div class="absolute top-3 right-3 print:hidden opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:focus-within:opacity-100"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="sm" class="cds-reset group/btn relative isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 text-muted" aria-label="Copy code" id="_R_7476aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1.25rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:433.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button><span role="status" class="sr-only"></span></div></div>
<p><code>between_tools</code> works on every platform that offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, with no beta header. It&#x27;s accepted at <code>low</code>, <code>medium</code>, and <code>high</code> effort. At <code>xhigh</code> or <code>max</code>, it returns a 400 error. To run at those levels, use adaptive thinking: omit the <code>thinking</code> field or send <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code>. <code>between_tools</code> takes no other field: <code>display</code>, <code>budget_tokens</code>, or <code>block_binding</code> sent with it returns a 400 error. With <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#server-side-fallback">server-side fallback</a>, a <code>between_tools</code> request that falls back to Claude Sonnet 5 runs there with <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>.</p>
<p>With <code>between_tools</code>, effort can&#x27;t change mid-conversation: a per-message <code>output_config.effort</code> that differs from the level in effect returns a 400 error. To vary effort per turn, use adaptive thinking. For prompting guidance, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5-5#running-without-up-front-thinking">Running without up-front thinking</a>.</p>

<h2 id="migration-checklist" class="group">Migration checklist by starting model<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_25v6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>

<ul>

<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-sonnet-5" class="group">Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Claude Sonnet 5<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_28v6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>Every starting model needs the changes in this section. Replace your model ID with <code>claude-sonnet-5-5</code>, which has no date suffix. On other platforms, use the ID listed under <a href="/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5#availability">Availability</a>.</p>
<h3 id="forced-tool-use" class="group">Forced tool use is not supported<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_29f6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Every earlier model on this page accepts a <code>tool_choice</code> of type <code>any</code> or <code>tool</code>. Claude Sonnet 5.5 rejects both with a 400 error, including on the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting">token counting</a> endpoint:</p>
<div data-not-prose="true" class="overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface-2 group relative"><div data-copy-scope="" class="code-block-scroll relative py-4 pl-4 text-code code-block-wrap"><pre class="block w-full pr-4" data-code-source="" translate="no"><code>tool_choice: type &quot;tool&quot; and &quot;any&quot; are not supported for this model.</code></pre></div><div class="absolute top-3 right-3 print:hidden opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:focus-within:opacity-100"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="sm" class="cds-reset group/btn relative isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 text-muted" aria-label="Copy code" id="_R_79v6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1.25rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:433.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button><span role="status" class="sr-only"></span></div></div>
<p>Send <code>tool_choice: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;auto&quot;}</code>, and mark the tool <code>strict: true</code> so its input matches the schema. The model can then answer without calling the tool, so say in the prompt when to use it. <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/strict-tool-use">Strict tool use</a> supports a subset of JSON Schema and needs <code>additionalProperties: false</code> on every object. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs#json-schema-limitations">JSON Schema limitations</a>. On Amazon Bedrock, <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs">structured outputs</a>, which include strict tool use, aren&#x27;t available for Claude Sonnet 5.5. There, send <code>auto</code> without <code>strict</code>, say in the prompt when to call the tool, and validate the tool input in your code.</p>

<p>The example marks every tool in the list strict. A request can have at most 20 strict tools, and the MCP, computer use, and browser use toolset entries don&#x27;t accept <code>strict</code>. In a longer tools list, mark only the tools that need it.</p>
<h3 id="thinking-blocks" class="group">Thinking blocks are tied to the model and the conversation<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2bn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Claude Sonnet 5.5 reads thinking blocks from Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Haiku 4.5, and earlier models, and, on the Claude API and Google Cloud, from Claude Haiku 5.5. It doesn&#x27;t read blocks from Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, or any Claude Fable or Claude Mythos model. The API drops blocks the model can&#x27;t read. The request still returns 200, and dropped blocks aren&#x27;t billed. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#switching-models">Switching models mid-conversation</a>.</p>
<p>Each Claude Sonnet 5.5 thinking block is also signed over the conversation before it. For accounts created on or after August 31, 2026, 00:00 UTC, the API enforces this by default, on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud. On those accounts, a request that replays a block after an edit to earlier history returns a 400 error. Keep conversations append-only, and change instructions or tools with <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages">mid-conversation system messages</a>. Thinking blocks that Claude Sonnet 5.5 produces work only in the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#account-bound-thinking">Preserved thinking</a>.</p>
<h3 id="computer-use-toolset" class="group">Computer use needs the toolset on the Claude API and Google Cloud<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2cf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>On the Claude API and Google Cloud, Claude Sonnet 5.5 supports computer use only through the <code>computer_toolset_20260801</code> toolset. There, <code>computer_20251124</code> returns a 400 error. Claude Sonnet 5.5 doesn&#x27;t accept <code>computer_20250124</code> on any platform. Find the version you send today:</p>

<p>If you send the <code>fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14</code> beta header, remove it when you move to the toolset. Alongside a toolset entry, it returns a 400 error. Set <code>eager_input_streaming: true</code> on each tool that needs it instead.</p>
<p>Code that already sends the toolset needs no change. <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#migrate-from-computer-20251124">Migrate from <code>computer_20251124</code></a> lists the request and agent-loop changes. For other platforms, see <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#compatibility">Compatibility</a>.</p>
<h3 id="advisor-tool" class="group">The advisor tool accepts fewer advisors<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2dn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>With the <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool">advisor tool</a>, a Claude Sonnet 5.5 executor needs one of these advisors: Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Fable 5, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5, or Claude Mythos 5.1. Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Haiku 5.5 advisors return a 400 error. The advice comes back encrypted as an <code>advisor_redacted_result</code> block, so its text isn&#x27;t readable in the response. See <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool#model-compatibility">Model compatibility</a>.</p>
<h3 id="text-between-tool-calls" class="group">Text between tool calls is returned in thinking blocks<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2e76aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>On Claude Sonnet 5.5, notes longer than a sentence or two that the model writes between tool calls come back as <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#progress-updates">progress-update <code>thinking</code> blocks</a>, empty at the default <code>display</code>. Shorter remarks stay <code>text</code>. On Claude Sonnet 5 and earlier models, all text between tool calls comes back as <code>text</code> blocks. No request fails, but an interface that shows those notes goes quiet.</p>
<p>With adaptive thinking, set <code>display</code> to <code>&quot;updates&quot;</code> (beta, <code>thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18</code> header) to get the updates alone, or to <code>&quot;summarized&quot;</code> to get them mixed with reasoning. Render each non-empty <code>thinking</code> block before the <code>tool_use</code> block that follows it. With <a href="#turn-off-up-front-thinking"><code>between_tools</code></a>, the text comes back without <code>display</code>. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5-5#user-facing-progress-updates">User-facing progress updates</a>.</p>
<h3 id="safety-classifiers-and-fallback" class="group">Safety classifiers and fallback<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2ev6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Claude Sonnet 5.5 declines in more categories than Claude Sonnet 5. A decline returns <code>stop_reason: &quot;refusal&quot;</code>, and its <code>stop_details</code> can name one of these <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#refusal-response">categories</a>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>&quot;cyber&quot;</code>:</strong> The request could enable cyber harm, such as malware or exploit development.</li>
<li><strong><code>&quot;bio&quot;</code>:</strong> The request could enable biological harm, such as dangerous lab methods.</li>
<li><strong><code>&quot;frontier_llm&quot;</code>:</strong> The request could assist the development of competing AI models.</li>
<li><strong><code>&quot;reasoning_extraction&quot;</code>:</strong> The request asks the model to reproduce its internal reasoning in the response text.</li>
<li><strong><code>&quot;general_harms&quot;</code>:</strong> The request falls under another usage-policy area. Benign work can also trigger this category.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#server-side-fallback">Server-side fallback</a> (<code>fallbacks: &quot;default&quot;</code>, beta, Claude API only) retries <code>&quot;cyber&quot;</code> and <code>&quot;frontier_llm&quot;</code> declines on Claude Sonnet 5. It doesn&#x27;t retry <code>&quot;bio&quot;</code>, <code>&quot;reasoning_extraction&quot;</code>, or <code>&quot;general_harms&quot;</code> declines. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback">Refusals and fallback</a> and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#how-refusals-are-billed">How refusals are billed</a>.</p>
<p>Real-time cyber safeguards are new for code from Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. For legitimate security work, apply to the <a href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude-opus-and-sonnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Cyber Verification Program</a>.</p>
<h3 id="other-changes-from-claude-sonnet-5" class="group">Other changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2g76aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Prompt caching:</strong> The minimum cacheable prompt is 512 tokens, down from 1,024 on Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.5. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-limitations">Prompt caching</a>.</li>
<li><strong>New features:</strong> For mid-conversation system messages, mid-conversation tool changes, and per-message effort, see <a href="/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5#feature-support">What&#x27;s new in Claude Sonnet 5.5</a>. With <a href="#turn-off-up-front-thinking"><code>between_tools</code></a>, effort can&#x27;t change mid-conversation.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="recommended-changes" class="group">Recommended changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2gn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Re-run your effort sweep. Claude Sonnet 5.5 has five effort levels: <code>low</code>, <code>medium</code>, <code>high</code>, <code>xhigh</code>, and <code>max</code>. The default on the Claude API is <code>high</code>. The levels are recalibrated, so a level doesn&#x27;t produce the same amount of thinking as on Claude Sonnet 5. Start at <code>high</code> unless your workload is agentic or latency-sensitive. For agentic coding and multistep tool use, start at <code>medium</code> for well-specified tasks and move to <code>high</code> for harder or longer ones. For chat and other latency-sensitive work, start at <code>medium</code> or <code>low</code>. Set the level in <code>output_config.effort</code>. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort#recommended-effort-levels-for-claude-sonnet-5-5">Recommended effort levels for Claude Sonnet 5.5</a>. Then re-evaluate model-specific prompt instructions against <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5-5">Prompting Claude Sonnet 5.5</a>.</p>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-sonnet-4-6" class="group">Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier Sonnet models<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2h76aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p><span id="migrating-from-claude-sonnet-4-6-to-claude-sonnet-5"></span>First apply every preceding section, replacing <code>claude-sonnet-4-6</code>. Then make these changes. On Claude Sonnet 4.5 or earlier, continue with the subsections that follow.</p>
<h3 id="sonnet-46-breaking-changes" class="group">Breaking changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2hn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p><strong>Thinking runs on requests that omitted it.</strong> See <a href="#thinking-on-by-default">Thinking runs by default</a> and <a href="#turn-off-up-front-thinking">Turn off up-front thinking</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Thinking budgets return an error.</strong> Claude Sonnet 4.6 accepts <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code> as a deprecated setting. Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 use it for all thinking. Claude Sonnet 5.5 returns a 400 error:</p>

<p>Remove the budget and set an <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort</a> level. There&#x27;s no fixed mapping from a budget to an effort level, so run your evaluations at two or three levels.</p>

<p><strong>Sampling parameters return an error.</strong> Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models and Claude Haiku 4.5 accept <code>temperature</code>, <code>top_p</code>, and <code>top_k</code>. On Claude Sonnet 5.5, a non-default value returns a 400 error. Remove them.</p>
<p><strong>Thinking text is omitted by default.</strong> See <a href="#thinking-in-responses">Handle thinking in responses</a>.</p>
<h3 id="other-changes-from-claude-sonnet-4-6" class="group">Other changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2kf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>About 30% more tokens:</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 uses Claude Sonnet 5&#x27;s tokenizer. Against Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5, the same text produces about 30% more tokens, depending on the content. Recount with <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting">token counting</a>, and revisit <code>max_tokens</code> and cost.</li>
<li><strong>Effort:</strong> <code>xhigh</code> is new, and the levels are recalibrated. See <a href="#recommended-changes">Recommended changes</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Images:</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 uses the high-resolution image tier, up to 2576 pixels on the long edge and 4,784 visual tokens per image. Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 stop at 1568 pixels and 1,568 tokens. A 2000×1500 image costs about 2.5 times as many tokens on Claude Sonnet 5.5. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision#evaluate-image-size">Resolution and token cost</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migrating-from-sonnet-45" class="group">Migrating from Claude Sonnet 4.5 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2kv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>On Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4, or Claude 3.7 Sonnet, first apply every preceding section, then these changes.</p>
<p><strong>Prefill returns an error.</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 rejects a prefilled last assistant turn with a 400 error, as Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 do. Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, and older models accept one. The error reads:</p>
<div data-not-prose="true" class="overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface-2 group relative"><div data-copy-scope="" class="code-block-scroll relative py-4 pl-4 text-code code-block-wrap"><pre class="block w-full pr-4" data-code-source="" translate="no"><code>This model does not support assistant message prefill. The conversation must end with a user message.</code></pre></div><div class="absolute top-3 right-3 print:hidden opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:focus-within:opacity-100"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="sm" class="cds-reset group/btn relative isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 text-muted" aria-label="Copy code" id="_R_7ln6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1.25rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:433.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button><span role="status" class="sr-only"></span></div></div>
<p>Replace each prefill according to what it was for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Output format:</strong> use <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs">structured outputs</a>, or tools with enum fields for classification. On Amazon Bedrock, structured outputs aren&#x27;t available for Claude Sonnet 5.5. There, describe the format in the prompt or use a tool without <code>strict</code>, and validate the output in your code.</li>
<li><strong>Preambles:</strong> ask in the system prompt for a direct answer.</li>
<li><strong>Unwanted refusals:</strong> clear instructions in the user message are usually enough.</li>
<li><strong>Continuations:</strong> move them to the user message, for example &quot;Your previous response was interrupted and ended with <code>[previous_response]</code>. Continue from where you left off.&quot;</li>
<li><strong>Context reminders:</strong> put them in the user turn.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Tool input escaping.</strong> Escaping in tool call arguments can differ. Parse <code>input</code> with a standard JSON parser.</p>
<p><strong>Computer use.</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 doesn&#x27;t accept <code>computer_20250124</code>. See the <a href="#computer-use-toolset">computer use table</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Effort.</strong> Claude Sonnet 4.5 has no effort parameter. Set an effort level explicitly, as <a href="#recommended-changes">Recommended changes</a> describes.</p>
<p><strong>Context and output.</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 has a larger context window, with no beta header, and a higher output limit. See the <a href="/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview">model page</a>. Remove any context-window beta header.</p>
<p><strong>Beta headers.</strong> Remove <code>interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14</code>, since adaptive thinking interleaves automatically. Replace <code>fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14</code> with <code>eager_input_streaming: true</code> on each tool that needs it. That header returns a 400 error alongside a computer use or browser use toolset entry. See <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/fine-grained-tool-streaming">Fine-grained tool streaming</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Structured outputs.</strong> The <code>output_format</code> parameter is deprecated and will be removed in the future. To use it anyway, add the <code>structured-outputs-2025-11-13</code> beta header. Without it, the API returns a 400 error. Use <code>output_config.format</code> instead.</p>
<h3 id="migrating-from-claude-sonnet-4-or-earlier" class="group">Migrating from Claude Sonnet 4 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2nv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Claude Sonnet 4 is retired on the Claude API and still available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud. Claude 3.7 Sonnet is retired. From either model, first apply every preceding section, then these changes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Tool versions:</strong> Use <code>text_editor_20250728</code>, with the tool name <code>str_replace_based_edit_tool</code> and no <code>undo_edit</code> command. Use <code>code_execution_20260521</code>. See the <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/text-editor-tool">text editor tool</a> and the <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool#upgrade-to-latest-tool-version">code execution tool</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Stop reasons:</strong> Handle <code>refusal</code>. Claude 4.5 and later models also stop with <code>model_context_window_exceeded</code> at the context window limit. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons">Handling stop reasons</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Trailing newlines:</strong> Claude 4.5 and later models keep them in tool call string parameters.</li>
<li><strong>Legacy beta headers:</strong> Remove <code>token-efficient-tools-2025-02-19</code> and <code>output-128k-2025-02-19</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Prompts:</strong> Review them against <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices">prompting best practices</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-haiku-4-5" class="group">Migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Claude Haiku 4.5<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2on6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p><span id="migrating-to-claude-sonnet-5-from-claude-haiku-4-5"></span>First apply every section up to and including <a href="#migrating-from-sonnet-45">Migrating from Claude Sonnet 4.5 or earlier</a>, skipping the Claude Sonnet 4 subsection. Then make these changes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Model ID:</strong> Replace <code>claude-haiku-4-5-20251001</code>, or the alias <code>claude-haiku-4-5</code>, with <code>claude-sonnet-5-5</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Cost:</strong> The price per token is higher, and the same text produces more tokens. Recount tokens and re-baseline cost. See <a href="/docs/en/about-claude/pricing">Claude pricing</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Prompt caching:</strong> The minimum cacheable prompt drops from 4,096 tokens to the <a href="#other-changes-from-claude-sonnet-5">Claude Sonnet 5.5 minimum</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Interleaved thinking:</strong> Adaptive thinking runs between tool calls automatically, with no beta header.</li>
<li><strong>Routing:</strong> Claude Sonnet 5.5 reads Claude Haiku 4.5 thinking blocks. A conversation that moves up keeps its reasoning. One that moves back down to Claude Haiku 4.5 drops Claude Sonnet 5.5&#x27;s blocks.</li>
</ul></div><div class="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-sm border-t pt-6 print:hidden"><p class="text-secondary text-body font-medium">Was this page helpful?</p><div class="flex items-center gap-xs"><button
